BeerVolta.rule:
- **Shop Rule (BeerVolta / BEER VOLTA)**:
Format 1 (NEW): `Japanese Brewery Name : Japanese Beer Name | English Brewery Name: English Beer Name [Volume]` (e.g. `バテレ : ネモフィラ | VERTERE: Nemophila 350ml`, `トートピア : スピンフォビア | Totopia: Spinphobia`). The pipe `|` separates Japanese and English portions. The colon `:` separates brewery name from beer name. ALWAYS extract brewery and beer names from the English portion after `|`.
Format 2 (OLD): `Japanese Name / English Brewery Name English Beer Name [Volume]`.
CRITICAL: Always remove volume/capacity suffixes (e.g. `350ml`, `568ml`, `355ml`, `473ml`) from both `beer_name_en` and `beer_name_core`. DO NOT confuse brewery names (e.g. Totopia Brewery is Totopia, NOT Teenage Brewing).

Chouseiya.rule:
- **Shop Rule (Chouseiya / ちょうせいや)**: Format is `[Prefix e.g. 30%OFF]【Beer Name / Brewery Name (Info e.g. 賞味期限/2026.07.08)】`.
CRITICAL: Inside `【...】`, the text BEFORE slash `/` is ALWAYS the Beer Name, and text AFTER slash `/` is ALWAYS the Brewery Name (reversed order!).
Ignore discounts (`30%OFF`), expirations (`賞味期限/...`), and labels. For non-beer (e.g. `発酵芳香蒸留水`), set `product_type` to `other` or `cider`.

Ichigo Ichie.rule:
- **Shop Rule (Ichigo Ichie / 一期一会～る)**: Format: `[Info e.g. 【7/29入荷予定】] Japanese Brewery Japanese Beer (English Brewery English Beer)`.
Extract English brewery and beer names from inside parentheses `(...)`. Carefully split brewery from beer name (e.g. `Adroit Theory Otoacoustic Emissions` -> Brewery: `Adroit Theory`, Beer: `Otoacoustic Emissions`). Remove shipping notes (`空輸`, `入荷予定`).
Ichigo Ichie.examples: 1. "【7/29（水）入荷予定】アドロイトセオリー オートアコースティックエミッションズ 空輸（Adroit Theory Otoacoustic Emissions）" -> {"brewery_name_jp": "アドロイトセオリー", "brewery_name_en": "Adroit Theory", "beer_name_jp": "オートアコースティックエミッションズ", "beer_name_en": "Otoacoustic Emissions", "beer_name_core": "Otoacoustic Emissions", "search_hint": "Otoacoustic Emissions Adroit Theory", "product_type": "beer", "is_set": false}

Arôme.rule:
- **Shop Rule (Arôme / アローム)**: Format: `[Air/Shipping e.g. (空輸)] Japanese Brewery / Japanese Beer Name (Style) Volume [English Brewery / English Beer Name]`.
ALWAYS prioritize extracting from the English portion inside square brackets `[...]`. The text before slash `/` inside `[...]` is the English Brewery, and text after slash is the English Beer Name. Remove volume/container info (`473ml缶`, `750ml瓶`) from `beer_name_en` and `beer_name_core`.
Arôme.examples:
1. "(空輸) ロアーブルーイング / エターナル・プランクスター (Hazy Double IPA) 473ml缶 [RaR Brewing / Eternal Prankster]" -> {"brewery_name_jp": "ロアーブルーイング", "brewery_name_en": "RaR Brewing", "beer_name_jp": "エターナル・プランクスター", "beer_name_en": "Eternal Prankster", "beer_name_core": "Eternal Prankster", "search_hint": "Eternal Prankster RaR Brewing", "product_type": "beer", "is_set": false}
